directionalConvergence.dedupDisposition: A3 provider-state, identity-role, credential and retention projections must defer to the accepted A1 owner contract; INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER must not bypass an accepted INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_WORKER vocabulary.
A3 must consume the exact accepted A2-selected provider route and budget lineage; it must not select a second route or create a second budget owner.

dependencies.requiredInterface: Accepted exact-five-state, provider, model, identity, permission, budget and tool contracts
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Local adapter projections only; the integrator must replace or prove exact compatibility

dependencies.requiredInterface: Canonical case, evidence, workflow generation, inbox, outbox, DLQ, attempt and budget ports
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Typed identifiers are carried but no case or queue owner is created

dependencies.requiredInterface: Atomic replay and semantic callback reservations, job audit, usage, effect and retention durability
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Injected port only; store unavailability denies acknowledgement

dependencies.requiredInterface: Owner-authenticated raw-body route that preserves bytes and invokes admission before parsing
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Pure callback admission function only; no route or middleware

dependencies.requiredInterface: Accepted S6 workload identity and external sandbox bindings plus OS-enforced filesystem and network isolation
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Separate NOT_CONFIGURED identity rows and declarative plans only

dependencies.requiredInterface: Owner-managed opaque credential injection and exact-route outbound proxy
dependencies.prestageBehavior: All routes disabled; only obviously synthetic invalid references accepted as fixture shape

dependencies.requiredInterface: Canonical kill, provider activation, permission, budget, approval and revocation decisions
dependencies.prestageBehavior: No control is created and no admission result grants authority

dependencies.requiredInterface: Explicit adapter from command section 2 configuration state to Product Assurance READY, NOT_CONFIGURED, UNAVAILABLE and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED posture
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Axes remain separate; no cast or READY projection

dependencies.requiredInterface: Independently administered sentinel and append-only audit delivery with readback
dependencies.prestageBehavior: No sentinel or audit sink is created

dependencies.requiredInterface: Opaque canonical-owner verification result plus authenticated expiring one-shot hook-binding reservation binding principal, provider, model, run, session, canonical worktree, tool, input, resource, budgets, approval, policy revision and hard denials
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Typed verified-evidence projection only; every shipped tool remains disabled, the Claude hook unconditionally denies as HOOK_BINDING_VERIFIER_NOT_CONFIGURED, and no local policy becomes authority

dependencies.requiredInterface: Atomic durable receipt for every accepted, duplicate, delayed, conflicted, malformed or authentication-rejected delivery
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Authenticated accepted and duplicate fixture deliveries model audit receipts; pre-authentication rejection persistence awaits the canonical audit owner

dependencies.requiredInterface: Per-role pinned model and CLI version, prompt, policy, schema, tool parity, retention, region, eval, budget, circuit and emergency-reserve qualification
dependencies.prestageBehavior: All posture fields are UNKNOWN_BLOCKED or UNQUALIFIED and no route activates

dependencies.requiredInterface: Canonical signed context manifest binding static-system hash, dynamic-context hash, evidence-bundle hash, phase, stop condition, prompt revision, retrieval bound, tool-depth bound, iteration bound and output-byte bound
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Provider requests carry prompt, evidence and policy revisions plus token and deadline bounds; tool requests and signed policy evidence cross-bind evidence-bundle and revision identities; descriptors bind input and output bytes. No signed context-manifest owner is created and activation remains denied

dependencies.requiredInterface: Owner-created dedicated disposable clone plus signed canonical source/common-dir/parent realpath evidence, locked detached worktree, process sandbox, resource ceiling and artifact retention
dependencies.prestageBehavior: Class-C command plan only; caller-asserted or unresolved paths are rejected, runner remains NOT_CONFIGURED and Main writes, merge, push and deployment stay denied
